I visited the Setia Alam Night Market (Pasar Malam Setia Alam) in Selangor Malaysia, which is famously the longest night market in the country.

Previously the Taman Connaught Night Market in Kuala Lumpur, which you've seen me cover in a previous vlog, held that record. I tried a bunch of different food there and did the same here at Setia Alam.

As it's 2.4 kilometers long there were so many different food options available, and I was looking to buy a bunch of different snacks that I've never before.

author: Dale Philip
description: I visited the Setia Alam Night Market (Pasar Malam Setia Alam) in Selangor Malaysia, which is famously the longest night market in the country. I saw a guy selling a variety of sausages and decided to try the Taiwanese one which I was warned was going to be spicy, but it was actually more sweet than spicy. It was like a candy version of a sausage.
